name: Ninja Swipe Strike 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Ninja Swipe Strike is a fast-paced 3D arcade challenge where you unleash your inner ninja through rapid-fire levels and precise throwing skills. You’ll stand on shifting platforms, swipe to launch deadly shuriken, and master long swipes that create massive blades capable of cutting down entire enemy groups.
